notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check MHS/drivers/robots/zhouxian__fluidlab --backend fake (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed; no hardware was attached, run or tested, and the upstream environment (the sim backend) was not installed or run. The card lists five entry symbols; this package serves the first one, fluidlab.envs.circulation_env:CirculationEnv (Circulation-v0), and the other four are left for follow-up packages. The upstream install needs python=3.7.13, gym==0.21.0, taichi==1.1.0 and a CUDA torch stack (environment.yml:27, :98, :250 and :28), so the fake backend is the package's own pure Python stand-in (fake.py) with a 9-value agent state; it models no particles, smoke, contacts or fluid forces. For this scene the real upstream observation is 5487 float32 values (70 body state, 9 agent state, 4056 smoke v samples, 1352 smoke q samples); the fake returns only the 9 agent-state values (position, quaternion, strength s and radius r), which is the smaller-array allowance of the guide and is named in the fidelity gaps. Five warnings are expected of this Gymnasium family driver and were left: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 with seed 7 (the seed only sets the seed of the next reset, so it makes no native call), and four G8.NO_UNIT for the bridge-derived integer inputs (seed in cap.world.reset.v1, seed in cap.world.seed.v1, action.values[*] which a simulator may use in its own units, and ticks). Only catalogue classes cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are used, so there are no catalogue requests. The clone has no LICENSE file at the pinned commit; the card's license_spdx NOASSERTION and license_class unknown were left unchanged and no licence was inferred. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package; gate.digest is the stable digest the check printed.
